read=lambda p:json.loads(p.read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'));sha=lambda p:hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
started=time.monotonic();manifest=read(D/'capture-manifest.json');reports=read(D/'reports.json')
for r in manifest:assert (D/r['name']).stat().st_size==r['bytes']==2097152 and sha(D/r['name'])==r['sha256']
def hashed(x):
 x&=0xffffffff;x^=x>>16;x=x*0x7feb352d&0xffffffff;x^=x>>15;x=x*0x846ca68b&0xffffffff;return x^(x>>16)
def operand(family,sample,row,k,right):
 index=k//2 if family==7 else k
 word=hashed(0x3958192 ^ sample*7919 ^ row*104729 ^ index*65537 ^ int(right)*99991)
 if family in (3,4,5) and k>=2**(family-2):return 0
 if family==0:return word&255
 if family==2:return (word&255)*(1 if right else -1)
 if family>=6:return (word&255)*(-1 if right and k&1 else 1)
 return (word&511)-256
def words(name,code='I'):
 a=array(code);a.frombytes((D/name).read_bytes())
 if sys.byteorder!='little':a.byteswap()
 return a
expected=array('i')
for family in range(8):
 for sample in range(64):
  a=[[operand(family,sample,row,k,False) for k in range(16)] for row in range(16)]
  b=[[operand(family,sample,row,k,True) for k in range(16)] for row in range(16)]
  tile=[sum(x*y for x,y in zip(left,right)) for left in a for right in b]
  for permutation in range(4):expected.extend(tile)
assert len(expected)==524288
comparisons=[];permutation_changes={};native={(r['wmma_dtype'],r['variant'],r['family']):r for r in reports if r['kind']=='wmma_dot_chain_diagnostic'}
controls={d:words(d+'-wmma.bin') for d in ('bf16','fp16')}
assert controls['bf16']==controls['fp16']
for dtype in ('bf16','fp16'):
 ref=controls[dtype]
 permutation_changes[dtype]=[sum(ref[(f*256+s*4+p)*256+c]!=ref[(f*256+s*4)*256+c] for s in range(64) for p in range(1,4) for c in range(256)) for f in range(8)]
 for variant in range(8):
  actual=words(f'{dtype}-chain{variant}.bin');floats=words(f'{dtype}-chain{variant}.bin','f');by_family=[]
  for family in range(8):
   start=family*65536;end=start+65536
   mismatch=sum(actual[i]!=ref[i] for i in range(start,end))
   wrong=sum(floats[i]!=expected[i] for i in range(start,end))
   maximum=max(abs(floats[i]-expected[i]) for i in range(start,end))
   r=native[dtype,variant,family]
   assert mismatch==r['wmma_raw_mismatches'] and wrong==r['exact_integer_mismatches'] and maximum==r['maximum_integer_error']
   by_family.append(dict(family=family,wmma_raw_mismatches=mismatch,exact_integer_mismatches=wrong,maximum_integer_error=maximum,
    mismatch_by_permutation=[sum(actual[(family*256+s*4+p)*256+c]!=ref[(family*256+s*4+p)*256+c] for s in range(64) for c in range(256)) for p in range(4)]))
  comparisons.append(dict(dtype=dtype,variant=variant,cells=524288,wmma_raw_mismatches=sum(x['wmma_raw_mismatches'] for x in by_family),exact_integer_mismatches=sum(x['exact_integer_mismatches'] for x in by_family),by_family=by_family))
# Inspect only permutation0 of the two-product family, using exact power-of-
# two error units. Both inputs and integer references are regenerated above.
native_values=words('bf16-wmma.bin','f');hist=Counter();sign_patterns={};examples=[]
for sample in range(64):
 for row in range(16):
  for column in range(16):
   cell=(3*256+sample*4)*256+row*16+column
   a=[operand(3,sample,row,k,False) for k in range(2)];b=[operand(3,sample,column,k,True) for k in range(2)]
   exponents=[abs(x).bit_length()+abs(y).bit_length()-2 for x,y in zip(a,b) if x and y]
   if not exponents:continue
   error=native_values[cell]-expected[cell];unit=math.ldexp(1.0,max(exponents)-24);ratio=error/unit;hist[ratio]+=1
   key=str(tuple((x*y>0)-(x*y<0) for x,y in zip(a,b)))
   sign_patterns.setdefault(key,Counter())[ratio]+=1
   if error and len(examples)<12:examples.append(dict(cell=cell,left=a,right=b,expected=expected[cell],actual=native_values[cell],native_bits=controls['bf16'][cell],error_in_max_exponent_minus24_units=ratio))
result=dict(kind='wmma_dot_chain_independent_raw_analysis',status='pass',native_report_rows_cross_checked=len(native),compared_cells=8388608,
 source_commit=read(B/'wmma-dot-chain-native-source-r1.json')['source_commit'],identical_bf16_fp16_wmma_words=True,
 comparisons=comparisons,wmma_changes_from_permutation0=permutation_changes,two_product_permutation0_error_histogram=sorted(hist.items()),
 two_product_error_by_product_sign={k:sorted(v.items()) for k,v in sign_patterns.items()},two_product_examples=examples,

from pathlib import Path
import struct,math,json,time,itertools,random,hashlib
B=Path(__file__).resolve().parent;p=B/'analyze_wmma_dot_chain_r1.py';scope={'__file__':str(p)}
exec(p.read_text().split("expected=array('i')")[0],scope)
operand,words=scope['operand'],scope['words'];native=words('bf16-wmma.bin');started=time.monotonic()
def from_bits(x):return struct.unpack('<f',struct.pack('<I',x))[0]
def bits(x):return struct.unpack('<I',struct.pack('<f',x))[0]
def inputs(cell):
 tile,position=divmod(cell,256);family=tile//256;sample=tile//4%64;permutation=tile%4;row,column=divmod(position,16)
 order=[k if permutation==0 else 15-k if permutation==1 else (k%8)*2+k//8 if permutation==2 else (k*5+3)%16 for k in range(16)]
 a=[operand(family,sample,row,k,False) for k in order];b=[operand(family,sample,column,k,True) for k in order]
 return [(a[i]*b[i],(a[i]<0)^(b[i]<0),abs(a[i]).bit_length()+abs(b[i]).bit_length()-2 if a[i] and b[i] else -126) for i in range(16)]
def predict(values,fractional,carry_offset,carry_mode):
 carry=0.0
 for base in range(0,16,2):
  terms=values[base:base+2];ce=((bits(carry)>>23)&255)-127 if carry else -126
  e=max(terms[0][2],terms[1][2],ce+carry_offset);q=math.ldexp(1.0,e-fractional)
  aligned=math.trunc(carry/q) if carry_mode=='rz' else math.floor(carry/q) if carry_mode=='rd' else -(math.trunc(-carry/q)+1) if carry<0 else math.trunc(carry/q)
  for value,negative,_ in terms:
   magnitude=math.trunc(abs(value)/q);aligned+=-(magnitude+1) if negative else magnitude
  carry=from_bits(bits(aligned*q))
 return bits(carry)
